title: Rule out a scalar pair placement by complete invoice dominance (no new κ)
body:
In the canonical shortest eight-field scalar root, a common rank-four stage at sites (1,2) forces a commuting common stage at (5,6) to have rank at least five. With rank-two endpoints and one granted fragment from each pure paired bank, every possible second-stage rank has a strictly worse complete invoice than an orientation-matched #6726 allocation, for every positive child allocation, binary subtree and 0<κ<1.

The new result combines universal actual-prefix geometry with complete cost accounting. Rank five has a forced target inventory and difference 104*(H(8C+1)-H(8C)-1)<0; an independent eight-inventory classification excludes all larger ranks in this fragment contract. Credit zxv #6726, thu-nmrc #6717, Ali Romman and Cinna Davis; their source constructions are inherited.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-scalar-pair-invoice-obstruction
```
Expected PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Primary and separate invoice checks pass normally and with -O. Independent geometry checks cover all 6,561 F3 parameters and six rank-five cases. Formal arbitrary-input identities, 16 allocation/orientation fixtures, all eight inventories, failed-prefix/missing-idle/endpoint controls, source pins, committed bytes/modes and unchanged Git-free primary replay pass.

No new κ. Scope: char!=2, the stated shortest scalar word, common commuting stages and exactly one fragment per nonempty pure bank. Fragments are granted, not constructed. Extra retirements, other fragment distributions, placements, larger first pairs and coupled controls remain open. The numerical ceiling corollary is conditional on #6726's unreplayed allocation-tail certificate; pointwise dominance is independent of it. All five framework assumptions remain.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate geometry/accounting reviews. No human/proof-kernel acceptance, selected cold replay or full-history preflight. Base 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a; exact source heads and digests: ORIGINS.json. Complete remote tree equals the tested tree.

Selected-baseline source bindings and metadata passed the required orientation check; this was not a construction cold replay.
